name: SENTIENT Furniture & Design Gallery
old_description: Signature collection and custom pieces for private residences, hospitality, and commercial interiors.
about:
SENTIENT Furniture & Design Gallery was founded in 2012 by Nersi Nasseri and Ali Yavari in the Greenpoint neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York. The studio occupies a 25,000-square-foot workshop that has housed craft and creative work for over three decades. Nasseri serves as president and creative director, while Yavari is CEO.

The company designs and fabricates custom furniture for residential, hospitality, and commercial projects. All processes—design, woodworking, metal fabrication, finishing, and upholstery—are performed in-house by a team of 25–30 craftspeople. The workshop can produce a single bespoke piece or a full furniture program for a 200-room hotel.

Clients include luxury hotels such as Edition Hotel and Four Seasons, airlines like British Airways, retail brands including Cartier and Porsche, as well as private residences. The firm works closely with architects and interior designers through a dedicated trade program offering priority scheduling and trade pricing.

SENTIENT emphasizes handmade construction using American hardwoods—walnut, oak, maple, cherry, ash—plus teak and ipe for outdoor use. Each piece bears a brass signature mark, and the company highlights sustainability through repairable, refinishable furniture. The studio has earned Best Furniture and Best Booth awards at ICFF and has exhibited in Dubai, Paris, Miami, and London.

about:
SLS Medical Supply operates from Lakewood, New Jersey, where it provides medical supplies and personal protective equipment to healthcare facilities across the United States. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The firm functions as a distributor, sourcing branded medical products and managing corporate accounts for institutional buyers. Services include 24/7 emergency support and a focus on cost-effective procurement.

Its customer base spans skilled nursing facilities, assisted living communities, emergency care centers, physician offices, clinics, dental practices, pediatrics, geriatrics, and hospitals. The company emphasizes reliable delivery and competitive pricing for high-volume institutional orders.

SLS Medical Supply positions itself on reliability, competitive pricing, and a customer service model built on honesty and integrity. It highlights 24/7 emergency availability and deep industry experience as key differentiators for healthcare providers seeking consistent supply chain performance.

about:
SMR-Metal Technology operates from South Windsor, Connecticut, where it provides metal manufacturing and fabrication services. The company emphasizes that its parts are made entirely in the United States.

The shop offers a full range of fabrication capabilities, including CNC laser cutting, punching, bending, sanding, deburring, milling, MIG and TIG welding, and final assembly. It works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, brass, and copper, and can apply powder-coat, paint, or plating finishes. The company accepts projects at any design stage, from sketches or samples through to finished parts.

Its customer base spans automotive, locomotive, aerospace, medical, energy, marine, defense, communications, restaurant customization, and original equipment manufacturing (OEM) sectors.

name: SNT AUTOPART ENTERPRISE, LLC
old_description: Parts helping to keep your Car hard at work with long work days.
about:
SNT Autopart Enterprise, LLC is headquartered in New York, New York, operating from an office 11th Floor. The company, known as SNT Autopart Group, has accumulated over 30 years of experience in the design, research and development, and manufacturing of automotive spare parts. Its primary product line centers on oil seals.

The firm supplies parts for passenger cars, pickups, trucks, trailers, and heavy-duty equipment. Its catalogs cover Japanese, American, and European vehicle manufacturers, including brands such as Alfa Romeo, Audi, Mitsubishi Fuso, and Iveco, as well as aftermarket names like AC Delco, BPW, and Eaton/Spicer. Production follows ISO 9001:2015 quality management and ASTM standards.

Customers span the automotive aftermarket and commercial vehicle sectors, with the company positioning its components as direct replacements for original equipment. The product range is organized by vehicle make and by competitor brand, indicating a focus on distributors and repair networks seeking OEM-equivalent parts.

SNT highlights its competitive edge through a leadership team that includes an executive with more than seven years of R&D experience at one of the world’s top three automobile manufacturers. The company states that its parts match the characteristics of original spare parts while offering a competitive price point.

name: SOLAR FX
old_description: Creating solar solutions for commercial, industrial, and agricultural facilities in the Midwest!
about:
Solar FX is headquartered in Boone, Iowa. The company was founded in 2008 by Gary Lass as a small family-owned business that began by installing solar-powered attic fans and residential solar arrays. In July 2023, Lass sold the business to his children, Jeremy (known as Oly) and Charise Lass; Charise later acquired full ownership while Jeremy remains as a field supervisor and Gary continues as an advisor.

Today Solar FX operates as a turnkey solar contractor, providing design, engineering, sales, and installation of photovoltaic (PV) arrays for agricultural, commercial, and utility-scale projects. All installations are carried out by in-house crews using company-owned equipment, and the firm manages the full permitting process, utility interconnection applications, and coordination with local jurisdictions.

The customer base spans hog barn operators, livestock farms, commercial facilities, and utility developers throughout the Midwest. Testimonials cite successful projects on agricultural sites such as a hog barn and a private acreage, as well as commercial installations.

Solar FX says its competitive pricing stems from buying panels directly from the importer of record, supplying only Tier One modules listed on the Bloomberg tier list, and remaining brand-agnostic to select the optimal panels, inverters, and racking for each custom-designed system.

SON Metal Fab operates from Ashland, Virginia, just north of Richmond. The business traces its roots to Butch Harrison, who founded the company as Specialty's Our Name with the strong support of his family; it later adopted the SON Metal Fab name. A founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication, welding, machining, and manufacturing services. Its capabilities include laser cutting, CNC punching, CNC bending, rolling, deburring, and powder coating, along with precision parts production. Equipment on the floor features a ¼″–10′ AccurShear with CNC controls, a Hurco CNC lathe with bar feeder, and a Hurco machining center. The company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

SON Metal Fab serves a broad range of clients in the Richmond, Virginia area. The website does not list specific industry sectors or named customers, focusing instead on local and regional project work of varying duration.

The company emphasizes its 30 years of industry experience and a dedication to craftsmanship and attention to detail. Experienced project managers are available to assist with drafting and prototyping, supporting customers from concept through production.

name: SPF ELECTRIC
old_description: A Leading Provider of Electrical Materials for Manufacturers, Installers & Contractors.
about:
SPF Electric, LLC operates from Angleton, Texas, where it has served the electrical power sector for over 25 years. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The shop specializes in electrical system fabrication, including bus bar fabrication (precision cutting, bending, punching, and shearing of copper and aluminum, plus aluminum bus bar welding), switchgear fabrication, G10/GP03 glass-epoxy components such as barriers and bus supports, relay panels, switchgear doors, and powder coating. All work is performed in-house using CNC cutting, vertical and horizontal press brakes, an iron worker, welding and stud welding equipment. The team also provides reverse engineering, CAD design, drafting, gasket installation, and hardware assembly, and has reverse engineered hundreds of doors, panels, and covers for switchgear, motor control centers, and transformers.

SPF Electric serves industrial, petrochemical, and electrical testing markets, as well as manufacturers, installers, and contractors who need custom electrical components. Typical projects involve switchgear, motor control centers, and transformers for facilities along the Texas Gulf Coast.

The company emphasizes that keeping every service under one roof enables faster turnarounds—quotes within three to five days, rush jobs in one to two weeks, and normal orders in four to six weeks—while maintaining quality through its CAD library of factory drawings for relays, switches, latches, and other accessories.

name: SPI Semicon
old_description: At SPI/Semicon, we manufacture semiconductor packaging solutions as advanced as the wafers they protect.
about:
SPI Semicon, headquartered in Ogden, Utah, traces its roots to 1970. The company was formed through the merger of two industry leaders, Semicon Systems and Semiconductor Products, combining decades of expertise in semiconductor packaging.

The company specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging, spanning front-end wafer fabrication to back-end finished devices. Its manufacturing processes include injection molding, vacuum forming, die-cutting, extrusion, and custom-made parts. Operations are supported by state-of-the-art facilities in the United States and the Philippines.

SPI Semicon serves the semiconductor industry, providing packaging solutions and components that meet or exceed EIA-541 and ESD 5.11.1 standards for resistivity and static protection. Its customer base includes semiconductor manufacturers requiring high-reliability packaging for advanced wafers and devices.

The company emphasizes innovation, quality, and exceptional service as its differentiators, backed by an ISO 9001 certified quality management system. Its unique product designs and unmatched packaging options are engineered to exceed the highest industry standards, reflecting a commitment to precision and reliability that powers technology worldwide.

name: STI Electronics, Inc.
old_description: STI Electronics, Inc. is a leading provider of comprehensive solder and electronic assembly training, designed to enhance skills and meet the stringent requirements of the industry.
about:
STI Electronics, Inc. was founded in 1982 by Jim D. Raby, P.E., in San Dimas, California. The family-run business relocated to Madison, Alabama, in 1993 and has since grown to over fifty professionals. Raby brought more than 55 years of industry experience, including a pivotal role in developing NASA and Department of Defense soldering schools.

The company provides contract electronic manufacturing, engineering and design services, rapid prototyping, new product introduction (NPI) builds, PCB assembly, rework and repair, advanced testing, and conformal coating. It operates analytical laboratories for materials testing and failure analysis, cleanroom manufacturing, and an IPC-authorized training center offering courses such as J-STD-001, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and IPC 7711/7721 at facilities in Madison, Alabama, and Houston, Texas, as well as online.

STI serves safety-critical, mission-critical, and military-grade applications across aerospace, defense, medical, industrial, and energy markets. Customers include organizations requiring high-reliability cable and wire harness assemblies, PCB assemblies, and specialized engineering support for low-to-medium volume, high-complexity programs.

The company emphasizes engineering-driven manufacturing where precision, reliability, and quality are essential. Its differentiator is the integration of advanced manufacturing, engineering services, analytical laboratories, and one of the industry’s most respected electronics training and certification programs under one roof, enabling customers to reduce risk and solve complex manufacturing challenges.
